text: dsh-wallet 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的钱包面板插件，在左侧栏底部显示 DeepSeek 账户余额、今日累计和当前会话消耗，并可悬停查看 token 与费用明细。宿主端读取 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY 查询官方余额，按会话事件和价格表估算费用，还提供 query_deepseek_balance 工具、可编辑的会话提醒阈值、低余额及超额系统通知，以及充值、API Key 和用量页面快捷入口。阈值保存在本机 ~/.dsh/dsh-wallet.json；可选的平台 userToken 用于官方用量校准。适合希望在 DSH 中随时查看 DeepSeek 余额和用量的用户。

dsh-wallet adds a DSH web sidebar panel for DeepSeek balance, daily usage, and estimated session cost with token details. It supports per-session spending alerts, browser notifications, official account links, and a balance lookup tool. Thresholds are saved locally.
想在 DSH 侧栏直接看 DeepSeek 账户还有多少余额。
有没有办法按会话查看大致花了多少 token 和费用？

余额低了或者当前对话太贵时，能不能弹出提醒？
想给每个对话设置不同的花费提醒上限并保存起来。
在聊天里让助手查询我的 DeepSeek 账户余额。
I want to see my DeepSeek balance and current chat cost in the DSH sidebar.
Can I get a notification when my balance is low or a session passes a spending limit?
dsh-wallet 的功能「账户余额」：面板通过 DSH 凭据查询 DeepSeek 账户的 CNY/USD 余额池，并显示低余额状态；用户可点刷新按钮立即重查。
dsh-wallet 的功能「会话与今日费用」：宿主按会话事件中的 token 用量和对应时段价格累计费用，侧栏显示今日累计及当前会话金额，悬停可看输入、缓存命中和输出明细。
dsh-wallet 的功能「费用阈值提醒」：用户可在面板编辑每会话金额上限；超过阈值时界面显示提醒并请求浏览器系统通知，设置写入本机配置文件。
dsh-wallet 的功能「查询余额工具」：助手调用 query_deepseek_balance 时，工具返回已配置账户的余额池、赠金与充值余额，并附官方充值入口。
dsh-wallet 使用前须知：余额查询依赖 DSH 中配置的 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY，并向 api.deepseek.com 请求余额；账户余额功能没有该凭据时不可用。
dsh-wallet 使用前须知：面板费用是从会话事件和本地价格表估算；可选平台 token 才会启用官方用量校准，官方账单可能延迟。
dsh-wallet 提供工具 query_deepseek_balance：查询已配置的 DeepSeek API 账户余额（CNY/USD 双余额池），返回总余额与低余额提醒，并提示官方充值入口。

dsh-wallet README · dsh-wallet：> Two builds: `main` is the **vk build** (vk slots only — install the [dsh-vk-suite](https://github.com/Ln1m/dsh-vk-suite) contract + skeleton first); the `official` branch is the **vk-free build** (no vk dependency, official slots only). **Use the vk build** — position: pinned at the sidebar bottom (`vk.sidebar.footer`).
> Conflicts: a slot renders only its highest-priority entry, and two registrations at the same priority throw; mutually exclusive with anything claiming the same position (see "How to use it / what it conflicts with" in [dsh-vk-suite](https://github.com/Ln1m/dsh-vk-suite)).

dsh-wallet README · dsh-wallet：A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) wallet plugin — a persistent panel at the bottom of the left sidebar showing your **DeepSeek account balance**, **today's total**, **current-session cost** (hover for the token / cost breakdown) and an **editable alert threshold**, with one-click links to the official recharge / API-key / usage pages, plus the model tool `query_deepseek_balance`. **Requires dsh-vk-suite**: the panel lands in its `vk.sidebar.footer` slot (persistent panel).

dsh-wallet README · ✨ Features：| Module | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Balance | Official `GET api.deepseek.com/user/balance` (Bearer auth via the DSH credential `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`) for the CNY / USD pools; 30s cache, exponential backoff from 5s up to 5min on failure |
| Today's total | Local **per-day aggregation** over the session/event stream, sharing its source with the session cost (today ≥ the session's own share today). The official billing endpoint is hourly-bucketed and lags ~10–20 min, so it is used **only as background calibration** |
| Session cost | `sessionProjections` tokenUsage × price table; `reasoningTokens` are already included in `outputTokens` and counted once; hover for input / cache-hit / output breakdown |
| Peak pricing | Auto-switched by Beijing time: **weekends are off-peak all day**, weekdays 9:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00 are peak (effective 2026-08-17 00:00; Flash repriced again at 2026-09-10 12:00) |
| Low-balance alert | Amber warning when CNY < ¥10 or USD < $2 |
| Alert threshold | Editable per session (default ¥5), **persisted** to `~/.dsh/dsh-wallet.json`; warns to start a new chat when exceeded |
| System notifications | Browser notification on low
dsh-wallet README · ✨ Features：> Panel numbers are a **local estimate**; the official bill wins whenever they disagree.

dsh-wallet README · 🏗 Architecture：```
Host (Node process)
├─ Balance: native fetch → api.deepseek.com/user/balance (30s cache + backoff)
├─ Today: per-day aggregation over the session/event stream; official platform /api/v0/usage as calibration
├─ Session cost: sessionProjections.tokenUsage × price table (flash/pro, peak-aware)

dsh-wallet README · 📦 Install / update：On this machine the local source is the single source of truth:

```powershell
$bin = "D:\DeepSeek_harness\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh\lib\bin.js"
node $bin plugin --profile web remove dsh-wallet
node $bin plugin --profile web add file:D:/DeepSeek_harness/plugins/dsh-wallet
```

Source of truth: `D:\DeepSeek_harness\plugins\dsh-wallet`. After editing the source you must remove + add to refresh the running copy (`~\.dsh\profiles\web\node_modules\dsh-wallet`), then restart DSH.

dsh-wallet README · 📦 Install / update：> Opening the recharge / API-key pages inside the DSH window requires the dsh-desktop app to handle the `NewWindowRequested` event. See [`docs/DESKTOP-EMBED.md`](docs/DESKTOP-EMBED.md).

dsh-wallet README · 📊 Official usage (optional)：Once a `userToken` is configured, the official billing data is used **only as background calibration** (returned in the `official` / `officialToday` fields of `/wallet/api/usage`); the panel's "Today" always comes from the local live aggregation:

dsh-wallet README · 📊 Official usage (optional)：1. Sign in at [platform.deepseek.com](https://platform.deepseek.com), open DevTools → Console, run `localStorage.getItem('userToken')`, and copy the `.value` field (NOT the `sk-` API key)
2. Write it to the `platformToken` field of `~/.dsh/dsh-wallet.json` (or set the DSH credential `DEEPSEEK_PLATFORM_TOKEN`)
3. Restart `dsh web`

> The `userToken` is session-scoped and expires. When it does, the plugin silently falls back to local stats.

dsh-wallet README · 💰 Price table (CNY per million tokens)：- Peak pricing took effect at 2026-08-17 00:00 Beijing time; events before that are billed at base prices (input miss / cache hit / output: flash 1 / 0.02 / 2, pro 3 / 0.025 / 6).
- The non-peak base prices are refreshed from the official pricing page; the peak bands have no public machine-readable form and stay hard-coded.
